 Jeonbuk vs Johor Darul Ta'zim, JDT Arrives with Formidable Momentum, Are the Hosts at Risk?
 Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors is looking to bounce back after dropping points in their last two matches, while Johor Darul Ta'zim arrives with high confidence.
 By: Damar Prasetya 
 | 
 Editor: Nayla Savitri 
 | 
 Contributor: Hanif Ramadhan 
 November 3, 2026, 18:01 WITA · 6 min read 
 Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors is scheduled to face Johor Darul Ta'zim in the 2026/2027 AFC Champions League Elite at the Jeonju World Cup Stadium, South Korea, on Tuesday (11/3/2026). 
 JEONJU, Aktualita.co -  The match between Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors and Johor Darul Ta'zim (JDT) is one of the intriguing fixtures on matchday four of the 2026/2027 AFC Champions League Elite East zone. Both teams are scheduled to meet at the Jeonju World Cup Stadium, South Korea, on Tuesday (11/3/2026) at 17:00 WIB or 18:00 WITA. 
 This duel brings together two teams in different conditions. Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors is trying to bounce back after losing points in their last two matches, while Johor Darul Ta'zim arrives with high confidence thanks to their consistent performance throughout the league phase. 
 Advertisement 
 Based on the standings heading into the match, JDT sits in fourth place with seven points from three matches. Meanwhile, Jeonbuk is in 10th place after collecting four points. 
 The result of the match in South Korea has the potential to influence the race for the round of 16. Jeonbuk needs a win to improve their position, while JDT wants to maintain their positive trend while increasing their chances of qualifying. 
 Jeonbuk vs Johor Darul Ta'zim Schedule and Live Broadcast 
 The match between Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors and Johor Darul Ta'zim takes place in the fourth week of the East region league phase. 
 Here is the match information: 
 Match: Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors vs Johor Darul Ta'zim 
 Competition: AFC Champions League Elite 2026/2027 
 Day/Date: Tuesday, November 3, 2026 
 Kick-off: 17:00 WIB / 18:00 WITA / 19:00 WIT 
 Stadium: Jeonju World Cup Stadium, South Korea 
 Live broadcast Indonesia: Vision+ 
 Live broadcast Malaysia: Astro Arena Bola 
 Viewers in Indonesia can check the broadcast via the Vision+ service according to the schedule and available packages. Meanwhile, Malaysian football fans can follow the match via Astro Arena Bola and the official Astro streaming platform. 
 Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors Seeks to End Winless Streak 
 Jeonbuk faces an important match after going through a less-than-satisfactory period in the Asian competition. 
 The South Korean club started the league phase with a 2-1 win over Kashiwa Reysol. However, in the following match, they lost 0-2 to Vissel Kobe before drawing 2-2 against Beijing FC. 
 That series of results left Jeonbuk with only one point from their last two matches in the AFC Champions League Elite. 
 Performance in domestic competition has also not been fully stable. Jeonbuk drew 1-1 against FC Anyang and was held to a goalless draw by Daejeon Hana Citizen at the end of October. 
 Jeonbuk coach, Jeong Jeong-yong, emphasized the importance of securing a win when facing the Malaysian representative. 
 "The match schedule is very tight. We must win this time. It will be an all-out battle," said Jeong in the pre-match press conference, as reported by Sports Chosun. 
 Jeonbuk is expected to rely on the support of the home crowd to increase pressure from the start of the match. 
 The presence of Lee Seung-woo in the attacking sector is one of the points of interest. Additionally, Andrea Compagno and Bruno Motta provide different options to break down the opponent's defense through physical play or finishing. 
 Johor Darul Ta'zim Arrives with an Unbeaten Record 
 Unlike the hosts, Johor Darul Ta'zim has shown impressive performance in the first three matches of the AFC Champions League Elite this season. 
 The team nicknamed the Southern Tigers opened their journey with a 1-1 draw against Buriram United, then secured a 2-0 victory over Pohang Steelers. 
 In the following match, JDT defeated Port FC with a score of 3-0 at the Sultan Ibrahim Stadium. 
 Those two consecutive wins have allowed the Malaysian club to collect seven points and remain at the top of the East region standings. 
 The success of defeating Pohang Steelers in South Korea is also a valuable asset. JDT has proven they can handle the pressure when playing at a K League club's home ground. 
 Marcos Guilherme is one of the players worth watching after scoring two goals in the win over Pohang. 
 However, JDT coach, Xisco Munoz, realizes that Jeonbuk will present a different challenge. 
 "The most important thing for us is to keep moving forward and maintain momentum," said Xisco, as quoted by The Star. 
 According to the Spanish coach, Jeonbuk has a strong defense, good midfield quality, and high-speed wingers. 
 Therefore, JDT must maintain balance in their play and not just rely on their success in previous matches. 
 Jeonbuk vs JDT Statistics, Who is Superior? 
 Looking at the results of the first three matches, Johor Darul Ta'zim has a better record compared to Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors. 
 JDT recorded two wins and one draw, scoring six goals and conceding only once. 
 Conversely, Jeonbuk collected one win, one draw, and one loss, with four goals scored and five conceded. 
 This comparison shows that JDT is more efficient in scoring goals and more solid defensively. 
 However, statistics are not the only deciding factor. Jeonbuk has the advantage of playing at home, while JDT must maintain concentration in facing the opponent's pressure. 
 This meeting is also the first duel between the two clubs based on available official match records leading up to the game. 
 Thus, both coaches must read the opponent's strengths without having the experience of a direct meeting beforehand. 
 Jeonbuk vs Johor Darul Ta'zim Prediction 
 The match is expected to be tight because both teams have significant interests in the battle for points. 
 Jeonbuk will likely try to control the game from the start. Pressure through the midfield and utilizing tall players could be a way to break down JDT's defense. 
 Meanwhile, Johor Darul Ta'zim has the ability to maintain ball possession and build quick attacks. The movement of their wingers could be a threat when Jeonbuk commits too many players forward. 
 The midfield duel is expected to determine the direction of the match. The team that is more effective at winning second balls and executing transitions will have the opportunity to create scoring chances. 
 JDT has the advantage in terms of consistency, but Jeonbuk remains dangerous when playing in front of their own supporters. 
 Considering recent performance, balance of power, and home advantage, the match has the potential to result in a narrow score. 
 Score prediction: Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors 1-1 Johor Darul Ta'zim. 
 This prediction is a pre-match analysis and not an official result. 
 Jeonbuk vs Johor Darul Ta'zim Lineups 
 The starting lineups for both teams will be confirmed through an official announcement closer to kick-off. 
 Jeonbuk has a number of options in the attacking line, including Lee Seung-woo, Andrea Compagno, and Bruno Motta. Meanwhile, JDT has players like Marcos Guilherme and Arif Aiman who can provide threats in the attacking phase. 
 Changes to the lineup are still possible based on fitness conditions, coaching strategy, and match requirements. 
 Regardless of who is fielded from the first minute, the Jeonbuk vs Johor Darul Ta'zim match is an important test for both clubs. 
 For Jeonbuk, a win is needed to revive their momentum. Meanwhile, JDT is trying to prove that their positive result against Pohang Steelers was no fluke and that they are capable of competing consistently against strong East Asian clubs.
